systematic_findings: POST-CHECK BUG (DOI title check): 6 of 6 doi_title_mismatch drops in wave 5 are correct DOIs. (a) Elsevier/Cell Press deposits only the text before the colon ('Hippocampus', 'Gain Modulation', 'Synchrony Unbound', 'Recovering Meaning'), and titles_match's prefix rule requires the shorter title to have >= 3 words: Eich04, SaliThie00, ShadMovs99, WagnEtal01. (b) A leading section numeral 'I.—COMPUTING MACHINERY AND INTELLIGENCE' fails both the numeral set and the 0.85 Jaccard: Turi50. (c) A one-letter registry typo in a short title gives Jaccard 9/11 = 0.82: ChabEtal98 'padiatric'. Suggest: accept a registry title that is the entry's pre-colon part when volume/issue/first page also match, ignore a leading 'I.'/section marker, and hold (not drop) near-misses. Related: the part-number guard in registry_title_matches is bypassed at postcheck.py:1034 by the bare titles_match(...) alternative (JacoEtal98 '... Virtual Space II' kept against Crossref 'Place Learning in Virtual Space'; right here, but the guard is dead).

POST-CHECK (network): 8 DOIs held and 4 identity/title quote checks failed only because Crossref answered HTTP 429 (CohnEtal21, KnowEtal94, DuchNeel89, SellEtal82, SpieEtal18 in the review set; JenkSmit01, HitcEtal05, FernGlen85 outside it; Jenk03 title, SquiEtal07 journal/pages). All 5 I refetched are correct. Pace or retry on 429 (with Retry-After) instead of caching a failure, then rerun.

POST-CHECK (surname hold counts only the researcher's quoted hosts): ToluEtal12 Changeux, VanEEtal01 Dickson, KrauEtal13 Robinson and WagnEtal01 Paré-Blagoev each have the second host in the Crossref record the post-check itself fetched for the DOI. The hold also fires on non-respellings: removing a mangled suffix '{Robinson I I }' (KrauEtal13), restoring a dropped accented letter 'Par-' -> 'Paré-' (WagnEtal01), and a parse artifact 'A A {and Artigas}' (ChamEtal03, outside the set). Count the DOI record's author list as a host, and exempt suffix removal and accent restoration.

Researcher errors: CareEtal19 keeps 'M A {van der Meer}' although its own quote reads 'M A A' (the same miss as wave 3's vandEtal17). SpieEtal18 is a VSS meeting abstract (per the researcher's own note) but was not flagged under the conference-abstract removal rule. MallEtal02 marked no_source, but the author's hosted PDF prints 'Künstliche Intelligenz, Heft 4/02, Seiten 24-28'.

No wrong value was applied in the random sample. Every B disagreement is a correct change the post-check held (surname hold, HTTP 429), or an initial the researcher left out. Researcher-proposed values checked against the sources were right in 53/53 B entries, apart from CareEtal19's kept initials and SpieEtal18's missing abstract flag.
